# FLX-2123: a committed run directory holds a file the run does not account for

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim ship` packs the whole run directory, and `fluxsim verify` reads the emit streams in it, so every file there has to be one the run itself wrote: the files `apply`, `ship` and `calibrate --write` write, the shares `apply --shard` writes, and, for each emit the receipt names, its stream, seam attestation, fidelity input and fidelity record. A stream file for an emit the receipt does not name (an extra `emits/<id>.ndjson`, for example), or any other file or directory the engine never writes there, was added after `apply` and is not covered by the run digest, so a pack would carry it as if the run had produced it. A share is read, not only named: `shard-I-of-N.json` needs I from 1 to N and has to agree with the plan and with the share beside it, and a share stream `emits/<id>.shard-I-of-N.ndjson` needs that record and has to be exactly the rows of the run's whole stream that share I of N holds. The refusal names the first such file, as a path relative to the run directory. Remove the file, or move it out of the run directory. `sink-receipts.json` and `calibration-provenance.json` are carried as the run directory holds them: nothing the run digest, the receipt or the plan binds says whether the run wrote them, so they are not covered by the run digest.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2123
```
